card.name: Right before beta-blocker or beta symbol
card.fires_on: The first byte of a broken-up Greek beta (β) in beta-lactam or beta-receptor, and words or commas just before 'beta-blockers' or 'β2-agonist' in warnings about asthma or bronchospasm.

modes.label: Broken beta symbol
modes.description: Half-written β character just before a hyphenated term like lactam or receptor.

modes.label: Just before beta-blockers
modes.description: The word or comma right before 'beta-blockers' in bronchospasm warnings.
modes.example: PATIENTS WITH BRONCHOSPASTIC DISEASES SHOULD IN GENERAL NOT<< RECEIVE>> BETA-BLOCKERS.

card.writes: It pushes against writing 'beta' or β next, so it acts as a signal that a beta term is about to come up.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say 'beta', as in beta-blockers or beta-lactams, especially in asthma warnings.
